name: Cradle

spine.record: table with typed fields and views

description: Organize business records, connect related data, and build forms and views for daily work.
scope: one business, one workspace; records builder with reviewed base imports and portable base exits; launch readiness is an included template with retained rights and data; repair navigation is opt-in and adds no authority
nonGoals: bidirectional sync with spreadsheets or other SaaS tools
automatic dependency rescheduling or critical-path optimisation
notification channels other than in-app and email
editorial content calendars and customer-feedback tracking
unrestricted runtime scripts, webhook effects or self-issued agent authority

externals.why: Magic-link sign-in and the operator notifications in NOTIFY-002 must reach email addresses outside the deployment.
data: recipient email
magic-link token or notification subject and body

externals.why: The campaign briefs, risk readouts, and lens proposals in AI-001 require a model; with AI off under SET-002 the rest of the product is unchanged.
data: context allowed by ai.campaign-context.v1
operator request

externals.why: Owner-authorized Gmail connection for configured mail actions.
data: authorized message content
mailbox metadata

externals.why: Owner-authorized Google Calendar connection for configured calendar actions.
data: authorized calendar events

externals.why: Owner-authorized Outlook connection for configured record calendar sync.
data: authorized calendar events

externals.why: Owner-authorized Xero connection for configured accounting actions.
data: authorized accounting records

externals.requiredWhen: A user enables a signed record webhook action
externals.why: Owner-selected receiver (owner-receiver) sends to custom destination record-automation-destination: An immutable encrypted public HTTPS receiver. The receiver belongs to the owner or their service; Cradle cannot perform its external action.
data: Record reference identifiers
record event and version
delivery identity
signature and timestamp

externals.requiredWhen: An owner enables a Twilio SMS automation action
externals.why: The owner's Twilio account sends through api.twilio.com and reads US A2P registration from messaging.twilio.com through the configured trusted egress relay. Twilio delivers SMS and enforces carrier registration.
data: Normalized triggering-record phone value
Owner-approved message text and inserted readable record values
Sending number or Messaging Service and delivery callback URL
Account credential for authenticated Twilio API calls

externals.requiredWhen: An owner installs the Slack app or enables a Slack app automation action
externals.why: The owner's OAuth-installed Slack app posts through slack.com using the trusted HTTPS relay. Signed Slack callbacks link native people, apply their policy-checked decisions and unfurl records they can read using owner-marked safe fields.
data: Owner-approved record primary field and automation text with inserted readable values
Owner-marked unfurl-safe field values readable by the linked poster
Native record links, opaque approval identifiers and channel selection
App credentials and OAuth code for installation; sealed bot token for Slack API calls

externals.requiredWhen: An owner installs Microsoft Teams or enables a Teams approval action
externals.why: Microsoft tenant OAuth on login.microsoftonline.com and Graph on graph.microsoft.com list joined teams/channels and send Adaptive Cards. Bot Framework keys from login.botframework.com verify callbacks; linked native people retain current Cradle write and read policy.
data: Owner-approved record fields and approval text
Readable owner-marked unfurl-safe fields
Native record links and opaque approval IDs
App credentials, consent code and sealed delegated Graph token

externals.requiredWhen: An owner installs a Nook app or enables a Nook approval action
externals.why: The explicitly configured public HTTPS Nook origin receives the declared Slack-compatible app Web API through the trusted relay. A scoped app token and signed callbacks use linked native people and current Cradle policy. The target API is edge-tested; a live Nook installation is not claimed.
data: Owner-approved record fields and approval text
Readable owner-marked unfurl-safe fields
Native record links and opaque approval IDs
Scoped app token and signed interaction metadata

externals.requiredWhen: A user enables a Slack automation action
externals.why: Slack (slack) sends to provider destination incoming-webhook: An immutable encrypted Slack incoming webhook. Slack owns the selected workspace and message delivery.
data: Owner-approved literal message text

externals.why: Optional owner-approved Auth installation for OpenID Connect sign-in. Existing accounts and product authority remain required. Email recovery stays available.
data: application origin and callback URLs
application public signing key and installation sector
OIDC authorization code, proof of possession and verified identity claims

externals.requiredWhen: An installation owner chooses an S3-compatible warehouse destination
externals.why: The buyer-selected public HTTPS S3-compatible endpoint receives SigV4-authenticated exports through the trusted egress relay. The buyer controls the bucket and object-erasure permissions.
data: Currently authorized selected-base record values and record identifiers
CSV or Parquet files, deletion tombstones and run manifests
SigV4 access-key identity and request signature

externals.requiredWhen: An installation owner chooses BigQuery for scheduled warehouse exports
externals.why: The buyer's service-account key signs OAuth assertions for oauth2.googleapis.com. bigquery.googleapis.com receives multipart CSV/Parquet load jobs and record-erasure SQL through the trusted egress relay.
data: Currently authorized selected-base record values and record identifiers
Export schema, file bytes and load-job identity
Service-account identity and signed OAuth assertion
Record-erasure IDs and verified count results

externals.requiredWhen: An installation owner chooses Snowflake for scheduled warehouse exports
externals.why: The buyer's Snowflake account SQL API authenticates with a key-pair JWT. Its named external S3-compatible stage supplies the exact exported CSV/Parquet files for COPY INTO and policy-aware erasure verification.
data: Currently authorized selected-base record values and record identifiers
Export schema, stage file path and deterministic SQL request identity
Owner user identity and signed key-pair JWT
Record-erasure IDs and verified count results

env.name: APP_ORIGIN
env.why: Canonical HTTPS origin for authentication links and redirects.

env.name: OWNER_EMAIL
env.why: Base operator-auth first-owner address; no implicit signup.

env.name: OWNER_NAME
env.why: First-owner display name configured during installation; defaults to Owner.

env.name: SETUP_TOKEN
env.requiredWhen: First-owner bootstrap on an empty Base auth store; remove after setup.
env.why: One-use deployment bootstrap authority, independent of mail and sessions.

env.name: MAIL_PROVIDER
env.why: Explicit Base mail provider: development for local outbox, sendgrid or resend for hosting.

env.name: SESSION_SECRET
env.why: Base HMAC key for opaque credentials and product session-bound CSRF.

env.name: INSTALLATION_KEY
env.why: Generated installation key seals Base dependency signing keys at rest; retain it with the private installation settings.

env.name: INSTALLATION_KEY_PREVIOUS
env.requiredWhen: During an explicit Base installation-key rotation or recovery.
env.why: Allows sealed dependency keys to be opened and re-sealed under the current installation key during rotation.

env.name: MAIL_FROM
env.why: Verified sender for magic links and operator notifications.

env.name: MAIL_PROVIDER_API_KEY
env.why: Authenticates the explicitly selected Base mail provider.

env.name: AI_PROVIDER_API_KEY
env.requiredWhen: AI is enabled under SET-002 and the default ai.provider.v1 adapter is used

env.name: AI_MODEL
env.requiredWhen: AI is enabled under SET-002 and the default ai.provider.v1 adapter is used
env.why: Selects the model recorded with AI usage.

env.name: EGRESS_RELAY_SECRET
env.requiredWhen: A user enables a signed record webhook action
env.why: Authenticate Cradle to its trusted egress relay for Owner-selected receiver; load from server-side secret storage and never expose to browser code or logs.

env.name: CONNECTION_ENCRYPTION_KEY
env.requiredWhen: A user enables a signed record webhook action
env.why: Encrypt private destination URLs and webhook signing keys for Owner-selected receiver; load from server-side secret storage and never expose to browser code or logs.

env.name: EGRESS_RELAY_URL
env.requiredWhen: A webhook or Slack action is enabled
env.why: The owner-configured trusted HTTPS relay endpoint; no token appears in this URL.

env.name: IDENTITY_PROVIDER
env.why: Optional HTTPS Auth installation for approved oidc-provider@1 pull linking. Blank installations retain email sign-in; linked sign-in is controlled by the owner identity setting.

operatingCost.status: not measured against a production workload
operatingCost.estimate: Deployment and usage costs depend on the Cloudflare account plan, resource usage and selected mail and AI providers.
operatingCost.assumptions: The account must support the declared Workers, D1, R2, Queues and SQLite-backed Durable Objects bindings. Confirm current plan eligibility, quotas and pricing before installing. Record-count limits are unmeasured capacity targets.
